sec.title: September 6 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 871)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 6** across William Powell and Ann Blyth starring in *Mr. Peabody and the Mermaid* on *Lux Radio Theatre* for Lux Toilet Soap (1948), George Burns and Gracie Allen getting ready for school on *Maxwell House Coffee Time* (1946), Manhattan homicide investigation on *Broadway Is My Beat* (1952), wartime combat commentary on *Gabriel Heatter* (1942), mid-century pop vocal selections on *Coke Time with Eddie Fisher* (1954), and eyewitness disaster coverage on *Radio News* regarding the torpedoing of the SS Athenia (1939).
All episode titles maintain pure canonical naming, with credited performers, conductors, and story details recorded in the narrative description:
